```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(unmarked)
library(MuMIn)
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tmaptools)
library(viridisLite)

```

```{r load-data}

umf <- readRDS("~/Repos/MGS/Data/UMFs/umf_recentered_scaled_dates_09172025.Rds")

df <- readRDS("~/Repos/MGS/Data/finalDF_2camsdeleted_20250917.Rds")

```

## Model 1: Intercept-Only

```{r intercept-only, warning=FALSE}

m1 <- occu(~ 1 ~ 1,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```


## Model 2: Date (Intercept on Occupancy)

```{r Date, warning=FALSE}

m2 <- occu(~ scaled_recentered + scaled_recentered_squared ~ 1,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```


## Model 3: Season Only

```{r Season, warning=FALSE}

m3 <- occu(~ season ~ 1,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```

## Model 4: Date + Season

```{r time-season, warning=FALSE}

m4 <- occu(~ scaled_recentered + scaled_recentered_squared + season ~ 1,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```


## Model 5: Distance to Stream


```{r Distance, warning=FALSE}

m5 <- occu(~ 1 ~ Dist_Scaled,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```


## Model 6: Date + Distance to Stream

```{r Date-Distance}

m6 <- occu(~ scaled_recentered + scaled_recentered_squared ~ Dist_Scaled,
           data = umf, 
           linkPsi = "logit")


```


## Model 7: Season + Distance to Stream 

```{r season-distance, warning=FALSE}

m7 <- occu(~ season ~ Dist_Scaled,
           data = umf,
           linkPsi = "logit")

```


## Model 8: 

```{r date-season-distance}

m8 <- occu(~ scaled_recentered + scaled_recentered_squared + season ~ Dist_Scaled)

```


```{r }

model_list <- list(
  "Intercept-Only" = m1,
  "Date (D)" = m2,
  "Season (D)" = m3,
  "Date + Season (D)" = m4,
  "Distance to Stream (O)" = m5,
  "Date + Distance to Stream (D+O)" = m6,
  "Season + Distance to Stream (D+O)" = m7,
  "Date + Season + Distance to Stream (D+O)" = m8
)

```
